reasons.medium: The accepted medium decision preserves the reference's live-action rendering; the request only authorizes motion and scene action, not a rendering-medium change.

reasons.lighting: The request explicitly places the car emerging from darkness, a visible illumination condition, so lighting is request-governed rather than the reference showroom lighting.
reasons.framing: No camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint or camera movement is requested; 16:9 is only a canvas ratio, so framing follows the reference.
reasons.palette: No scene color palette is requested; the black car is an object property, not a palette instruction, so palette follows the reference.
